title: 大壩止水帶施工~Dam waterstop installation
focus: 以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水~Forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality
summary: 本課以以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水為主線，先用水壓高度與接縫與接縫張開與伸長界定水力與構造條件，再將定位支撐與覆蓋、狹縫層流與敏感度連結到壓力保持與量測誤差。數值均為材料幾何與水量盤點，不能替代止水帶產品試驗、接縫設計與壓力驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality through Head pressure and joints and Joint opening and extension, then connects Positioning support and cover and Slot flow and sensitivity to Pressure holding and measurement error. Numbers describe geometry and water accounting, not substitutes for product testing joint design and pressure verification. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。數值均為材料幾何與水量盤點，不能替代止水帶產品試驗、接縫設計與壓力驗證。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Numbers describe geometry and water accounting, not substitutes for product testing joint design and pressure verification. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查水壓高度與接縫：waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa；再獨立檢查接縫張開與伸長：Ideal straight activeLength=80 mm; jointOpeningIncrease=6 mm; nominalStrain=6/80=0.075 dimensionless。敏感度：平行板層流缺口由0.20增至0.30mm且其餘條件不變，理想滲流量按三次方增加至3.375倍；實際粗糙接縫、湍流與曲折流路不一定遵守此比例。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。數值均為材料幾何與水量盤點，不能替代止水帶產品試驗、接縫設計與壓力驗證。 將比較實際水質下自由膨脹與受拘束試驗並檢查預膨潤作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Head pressure and joints: waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa. Independently examine Joint opening and extension: Ideal straight activeLength=80 mm; jointOpeningIncrease=6 mm; nominalStrain=6/80=0.075 dimensionless. Sensitivity: increasing a parallel-plate laminar gap from0.20 to0.30mm at fixed conditions multiplies ideal flow by3.375. Real rough joints, turbulent flow and tortuous paths need not follow this cubic relation. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Numbers describe geometry and water accounting, not substitutes for product testing joint design and pressure verification. Use the following independent check: Compare free and confined swelling in representative water and inspect premature expansion. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 水壓高度與接縫~Head pressure and joints
units.title: 水壓高度與接縫~Head pressure and joints
units.mechanism: 止水帶阻斷收縮縫或施工縫中的連通水路，所承受壓差與實際連通水頭相關。水深乘單位重只給靜水壓量級，不代表接縫任何點都處於同樣壓力；排水、局部缺陷與瞬變需另外辨識，才能確認試驗工況。 驗證時應對照接縫位置庫水位與下游排水壓力界定壓差，並辨識以下失效情境：下游排水堵塞會改變原先假設的接縫壓力分布。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Waterstops interrupt connected paths through joints. Differential pressure depends on the connected head, not merely a nearby water level. Depth times unit weight provides a hydrostatic scale; drainage, defects and transients create different local conditions and must be identified before defining a test case. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use joint elevation, reservoir level and downstream drainage pressure to define differential head. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Blocked drainage changes the assumed pressure distribution along the joint. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 對照接縫位置庫水位與下游排水壓力界定壓差。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「下游排水堵塞會改變原先假設的接縫壓力分布」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Use joint elevation, reservoir level and downstream drainage pressure to define differential head. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Blocked drainage changes the assumed pressure distribution along the joint. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 下游排水堵塞會改變原先假設的接縫壓力分布。診斷時應採取以下查核：對照接縫位置庫水位與下游排水壓力界定壓差，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Blocked drainage changes the assumed pressure distribution along the joint. Diagnose it by the following check: Use joint elevation, reservoir level and downstream drainage pressure to define differential head. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 附近水深就等於接縫每一位置的實際壓差~Nearby water depth equals actual pressure difference at every joint location
units.practice: 交接時以對照接縫位置庫水位與下游排水壓力界定壓差作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對下游排水堵塞會改變原先假設的接縫壓力分布，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Use joint elevation, reservoir level and downstream drainage pressure to define differential head. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Blocked drainage changes the assumed pressure distribution along the joint. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 接縫張開與伸長~Joint opening and extension
units.title: 接縫張開與伸長~Joint opening and extension
units.mechanism: 止水帶需配合接縫張開與剪切，活動區長度決定同樣位移對材料的平均應變。中心泡管可透過幾何變形吸收位移，因此直條拉伸式只示範尺度，不能當所有型式的應變分析；轉角與交叉點通常需單獨檢查。 驗證時應量測接縫張開與剪切並對照產品完整型式變形試驗，並辨識以下失效情境：把總帶寬當有效伸長區會低估局部應變。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Waterstops accommodate opening and shear. Active length determines the mean strain for a prescribed displacement, while a center bulb deforms geometrically. A straight-strip estimate illustrates scale rather than every product shape; corners and intersections require separate checks because they constrain deformation differently. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure joint opening and shear and compare with full-profile product deformation tests. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using total strip width as active length understates local strain. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Ideal straight activeLength=80 mm; jointOpeningIncrease=6 mm; nominalStrain=6/80=0.075 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Ideal straight activeLength=80 mm; jointOpeningIncrease=6 mm; nominalStrain=6/80=0.075 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using total strip width as active length understates local strain. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 溫度收縮與位移~Thermal contraction and movement
units.title: 溫度收縮與位移~Thermal contraction and movement
units.mechanism: 混凝土降溫會使接縫張開，但相鄰塊體的約束與溫度分布影響實際位移。自由熱縮量只能提供上限或參考尺度，不能直接等同現場縫寬；監測需同時記錄溫度與接縫位移，分辨季節循環與不可逆變形。 驗證時應比對塊體溫度與接縫計時序並標記約束變化，並辨識以下失效情境：將自由熱縮直接當縫寬會忽略相鄰塊體共同移動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Cooling can open joints, but restraint and temperature distribution govern actual movement. Free thermal contraction supplies a reference scale rather than the installed joint width. Record temperature and displacement together to distinguish seasonal cycling from irreversible change and avoid attributing every movement to temperature alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare block temperatures and joint-meter histories and identify restraint changes. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Equating free contraction with gap width ignores common movement of adjacent blocks. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 焊接接續與搭接~Splice continuity and joining
units.title: 焊接接續與搭接~Splice continuity and joining
units.mechanism: 熱塑止水帶需用適用程序形成連續熔接，金屬或其他材料則需對應接續方式。接合面積乘名義應力只是一項示意，實際接頭的缺口、污染與型式變形會控制失效；應檢查完整剖面而非只看表面接縫漂亮。 驗證時應保留接頭試片破壞位置與斷面影像並核對製程參數，並辨識以下失效情境：外觀平整仍可能存在未熔合或內部氣孔。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Thermoplastic waterstops need qualified fusion procedures, while metal and other materials use different joining methods. Area times nominal stress is illustrative only; notches, contamination and profile deformation can govern failure. Inspect the full section rather than judging the joint by surface appearance alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Retain coupon failure locations and section images and check joining-process records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A smooth exterior can conceal incomplete fusion or internal voids. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Illustrative tensile coupon: bondedArea=120 mm2; failureLoad=1800 N; nominalStress=1800/120=15 MPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Illustrative tensile coupon: bondedArea=120 mm2; failureLoad=1800 N; nominalStress=1800/120=15 MPa. units.anchor: 定位支撐與覆蓋~Positioning support and cover
units.title: 定位支撐與覆蓋~Positioning support and cover
units.mechanism: 止水帶需在澆置期間保持中心位置與足夠埋入深度，偏移會縮短繞流路徑或露出翼緣。幾何覆蓋扣減可示範誤差餘量，但還需考慮轉角和施工接續；支撐方式不可任意穿刺主要止水區造成新滲漏點。 驗證時應澆置前後量測中心線與埋入尺寸並記錄固定點，並辨識以下失效情境：澆置沖擊使止水帶翻折會形成隱藏連通空隙。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~The strip must retain its center and embedment during placement. Displacement shortens bypass paths or exposes ribs. A geometric cover deduction shows tolerance consumption but does not address corners and intersections; supports must avoid puncturing the primary barrier and introducing new leakage paths. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey centerline and embedment before and after placement and record supports. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Placement impact can fold the strip and create concealed connected voids. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：nominalEmbedment=150 mm; positioningError=25 mm; remainingEmbedment=150-25=125 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: nominalEmbedment=150 mm; positioningError=25 mm; remainingEmbedment=150-25=125 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 混凝土包覆與空洞~Concrete encapsulation and voids
units.title: 混凝土包覆與空洞~Concrete encapsulation and voids

In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Continuous honeycombing beneath the strip lets water bypass an undamaged barrier. units.anchor: 狹縫層流與敏感度~Slot flow and sensitivity
units.title: 狹縫層流與敏感度~Slot flow and sensitivity
units.mechanism: 平行板層流模型顯示縫隙開度對流量有立方影響，細小位移也可能明顯改變滲漏。此式限於光滑平行板、牛頓流體及層流，實際粗糙接縫可能有接觸點與曲折流路；應用它辨識敏感度而非預測未查明裂縫的精確漏量。 驗證時應比較同壓差下漏量對開度的變化並確認是否仍為層流，並辨識以下失效情境：將立方律延用至湍流大縫隙會錯估漏量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Parallel-plate laminar flow has cubic sensitivity to aperture, so small opening changes can strongly affect leakage. The relation assumes smooth parallel walls, a Newtonian fluid and laminar conditions. Rough contacts and tortuous joints violate these assumptions; use it for sensitivity rather than exact leakage prediction. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare leakage versus opening at fixed pressure difference and check laminar applicability. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extending the cubic law to a large turbulent gap misstates leakage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 材料膨脹與拘束~Material swelling and restraint
units.title: 材料膨脹與拘束~Material swelling and restraint
units.mechanism: 膨潤型材料遇水增大體積，但拘束空間與化學環境會影響密封效果及對混凝土的作用。自由膨脹比不是受拘束壓力，不能由體積直接換算力；需依產品相容性、預膨潤控制與代表性接縫試驗確認適用。 驗證時應比較實際水質下自由膨脹與受拘束試驗並檢查預膨潤，並辨識以下失效情境：澆置前先膨脹可能降低後續可用變形餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Hydrophilic materials expand in water, but confinement and chemistry control sealing and concrete interaction. Free swelling ratio is not restrained pressure and cannot be converted directly into force. Evaluate compatibility, premature swelling control and representative joint tests using product-specific information. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare free and confined swelling in representative water and inspect premature expansion. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Swelling before concreting can reduce subsequent accommodation reserve. units.anchor: 分區漏量與定位~Zoned leakage and localization
units.title: 分區漏量與定位~Zoned leakage and localization
units.mechanism: 接縫漏水應分區收集並與水位及溫度同步，總漏量下降可能只是流路轉移而非修補成功。量測容積除時間提供直接流量，但集水效率與暫態蓄水仍需核對；染色或其他定位方法也須符合水質與工程程序。 驗證時應以相同水頭比較修補區及相鄰區漏量並核對集水效率，並辨識以下失效情境：只看修補點乾燥可能漏掉滲流轉往相鄰接縫。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Collect joint leakage by zone and align it with head and temperature. A lower total may reflect pathway diversion rather than successful repair. Timed volume gives discharge directly, but collection efficiency and transient storage still matter; localization methods must follow the relevant engineering and water-quality procedures. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare repaired and adjacent zones at matching head and verify collection efficiency. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A dry repaired point can conceal diversion into an adjacent joint. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 壓力保持與量測誤差~Pressure holding and measurement error
units.title: 壓力保持與量測誤差~Pressure holding and measurement error
units.mechanism: 封閉水路壓力試驗需分辨漏水、溫度與系統柔度造成的壓力變化，壓降不直接等於漏量。若以已率定體積柔度換算，只在小變形且溫度穩定時成立；應保留水溫、補水量及壓力校正，避免單一壓力曲線過度推論。 驗證時應核對水溫與系統柔度並以補水體積交叉驗證壓降，並辨識以下失效情境：溫降造成的壓力降低可能被誤判為止水漏失。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A pressure-hold test must separate leakage from temperature and system compliance. Pressure drop is not directly a leak rate. Conversion through calibrated volumetric compliance assumes small changes and stable temperature; retain temperature, makeup volume and calibration records before interpreting one pressure trace. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check water temperature and system compliance and cross-check pressure loss using makeup volume. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Cooling-induced pressure reduction can be mistaken for leakage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
